role: Base ISaveFormat over the saves directory: lists worlds for the singleplayer menu, reads a world's level.dat into a WorldInfo, renames and recursively deletes world folders, and hands out a SaveHandler. AnvilSaveConverter extends it.
scope_reason: Save-directory management (world list, rename, delete, format conversion) is menu and disk plumbing; the native engine starts from oracle snapshots (worldinfo.nbt written by oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/Snapshot.java), never from a saves folder.
